status: Frozen scoring revision for future S8.3 samples. Exact-argument scoring v1 and every v1 result remain preserved and runnable; nothing is re-labelled or retroactively passed.
owner_approved_change: Semantic rubric: idempotency key non-empty/uniqueness/replay, normalized text meaningful source-backed content/effects; exact tool intent, scoped ids/revisions, financial/time/amount constraints and authority boundaries preserved; cases, denominators, prompts, fixture and tool schema immutable; versioned contract frozen before new trials; no retroactive PASS; proposed numeric targets unchanged.

supersedes.scoring: v1 exact dict/list equality of calls in tools/slm/s8_contract.py, still available as `score <results> --scoring v1`
supersedes.reason: the S8.3-a2 discriminator showed one functionally correct call failing only because the frozen expectation required a literal idempotency key (9/11 call-bearing cases), a free-form normalized text (6 cases), and producer-only labels no supplied input states

changed_with_reason.profiles: the descriptive scoring block now declares this v2 rubric; every numeric target, symbol and denominator is unchanged

idempotency_key.note: The application refuses a blank key and stores one durable operation per key; the same key with a different caller or payload is a conflict. The contract enforces only that application rule plus size and per-case uniqueness: a non-blank key with surrounding whitespace is a distinct valid key, exactly as the application stores it. Cross-case uniqueness is the harness's per-case isolated-database responsibility.

source_backed_text.note: Deterministic checks only: non-empty, no control characters, at least one non-neutral content token shared with the source span or stated merchant (exact or >=4-character prefix), and every stated number explained by the source span, the amount, or a stated date/time component. A paraphrase that satisfies those checks is accepted.

unresolved_reason_label.note: The application accepts any non-blank reason string and no product vocabulary exists, so only the unresolved decision, non-emptiness, bounded size and absence of control characters are graded.

extraction_version.note: Producer-supplied provenance, never compared to a literal. The score output records the declared value so mixed producers stay visible; verifying which extractor produced a reading is a future adapter responsibility, not a claim of this scorer.

provenance.note: A results document that omits its binding or declares another version/hash fails every case instead of qualifying silently. The report itself records the exact bound inputs and its own scoring-contract digest.

evidence_fields.stored_reading: required for every update_event_interpretation call: the app-stored note_events row derived from the real instrumented trace
evidence_fields.replay: required whenever a replay is claimed: repeated dispatch outcomes, the single durable operation row and equal before/after state digests
evidence_fields.replay_probe: required once per profile before a score report is complete for qualification; reported as missing, valid or invalid and never inferred from a boolean

boundaries.semantic_paraphrase_quality: Whether a source-backed reading is the best paraphrase is human judgement. The machine checks non-emptiness, source tokens, numeric facts and the stored effect; it does not rank paraphrases.
boundaries.unresolved_reason_label: The label vocabulary is deliberately not fixed: the application accepts any non-blank reason, so only the unresolved decision, non-emptiness, bounded size and control characters are graded.
boundaries.extraction_version_label: The producer version is not compared to a literal because no prompt-visible value exists; it is recorded and required to be consistent within a case.
boundaries.merchant_label: The frozen multi-event expectations label the source word 'fuel' as the merchant. That authored choice is kept exactly; a defensible null merchant would still fail. Disclosed, not silently changed.
boundaries.expected_link_revision: attach_link.expectedRevision 0 is the initial revision of a freshly proposed link, derived from application revision semantics rather than prose. It stays exact.
boundaries.replay_evidence: The scorer verifies the structure and internal consistency of replay evidence, not that an unobserved device run happened; raw trace review remains required.
boundaries.cross_case_key_uniqueness: The application key table is unique per database and each case runs in a fresh isolated database, so key uniqueness is enforced within a case; per-case isolation is the harness's responsibility.
